title: junit2context JSON output, schema version 1
description: The existing CLI envelope. Unknown properties are accepted at both levels; all current properties are required.

failure_count.description: Number of unique failure records in failures.

truncated_details.description: Number of records whose sanitized details were shortened.

truncated_messages.description: Number of records whose sanitized message was shortened.

source.description: Sanitized path of the first report containing this unique record; not necessarily a URI or an existing path for the reader.

classname.description: May be empty when the report provides no class name.

message.description: Sanitized message, possibly empty or containing an excerpt notice.

details.description: Sanitized details, possibly empty or containing an excerpt notice.
